name: Original-mission terminal commitment with bounded stale-home guidance

scope.evidence: One released M06 seed2 development fork at step359; no cross-map validation

node_semantics.decision: Read feature, compare with op and value, follow yes/no. Read leaf.value as result.
node_semantics.missing_numeric: Every numeric comparison with missing/nonfinite input returns false. Required validity booleans must be explicitly true.
evaluation_order: derive current legal features and prior_latched
assign clear_active from latch_H result and persist H latch
apply outputs to already computed frozen baseline commands

binding_contract.selection: Before any skill effect, bind every original H attack assignment to a public sentry and every original M attack assignment to a public mother. Retain original mission and public initial target coordinate.
binding_contract.identity_use: Opaque actor/target handles only index state and address original commands; they never select behavior by historical outcome.
binding_contract.availability: Only process an actor when its normal planner provides an authorized current observation/action. No replacement actors.

state_contract.initial: At episode initialization, H prior_latched=false, own altitude previous report absent, own received-track history empty; track each original binding independently. Carry chronological pre-fork memory into all branches.
state_contract.altitude: For each new authorized actor action/report, previous=(environment_step, own_altitude_m). vertical_speed_valid iff previous exists and 1<=step_delta<=5. vertical_speed_mps=(current_altitude-previous_altitude)/step_delta. Always replace previous with current after deriving this value, as measured runtime does.
state_contract.latch: latch_H ORs prior_latched with intact-binding, own-track age0..2, valid negative vertical speed, and range<=2000. Once true it persists for the episode even if range grows or binding/track temporarily invalid. Invalid binding/age blocks clear_H, without erasing the latch. No synthetic fresh-entry event is required on recovery.
state_contract.clear_active: Post-update latch, not prior latch. A newly qualifying H can clear on the same step.
state_contract.history: Per actor/source/original target, append only received observations whose target timestamp strictly exceeds the last stored timestamp. On append retain entries within5s of new timestamp. Do not prune because wall time passes; repeated stale reports retain prior distinct positions. Select latest older timestamp with1..5s gap. Never derive velocity from repeated same-stamp reports.
state_contract.termination: Actor ceases emitting commands through ordinary baseline lifecycle. Binding mismatch or failed live guards yields baseline for that step; no reassignment, target-health gate, or global future-outcome dependency.
state_contract.P_memory: P has no latch: recompute guards and point each step. Only two-position own-received history is used. M clear latch has no selected action and need not affect outputs.

inputs: binding_matches from current mission versus original opaque target handle
own current longitude,latitude,altitude and environment step
own received target longitude,latitude,timestamp plus past authorized reports
ignored_inputs: native target velocity, although legally logged
feature_calculation.coordinate_convention: longitude and latitude in degrees; positions may include altitude but horizontal range ignores it. Preserve measured local mean-latitude approximation, not a new geodesic implementation.
feature_calculation.role: H or M from frozen binding; no C behavior selected.
feature_calculation.own_track_present: true iff own legally received report contains finite position and timestamp. Public initial position alone is not an own report.
feature_calculation.age_s: current authorized absolute time_s - own_track.timestamp_s; do not clamp negative age.
feature_calculation.range_m: distance(current own actor position, literal latest own received target position). Do not use predicted point for the range gate.
feature_calculation.velocity_history_valid: Two distinct own received positions with estimator_dt_s in[1,5], finite east/north estimates. Native legal velocity is never substituted.
feature_calculation.velocity_formula: Let p=current received position and q=latest eligible previous position, dt=p.timestamp-q.timestamp. v_e=(p.lon-q.lon)*111320*cos(radians((p.lat+q.lat)/2))/dt; v_n=(p.lat-q.lat)*110570/dt.
feature_calculation.home_time_valid: home_time_s is finite; positive checked by separate node
feature_calculation.home_segment_fraction: min(age_s/home_time_s,1), evaluated only after positive finite home_time and age guards
feature_calculation.point_in_map: Both coordinates finite and public west<=lon<=east and south<=lat<=north, inclusive.
feature_calculation.dependency_order: Compute dependent features only after their prerequisites are valid; otherwise mark undefined and relevant validity false. No divide-by-zero or missing-coordinate inference.

output_contract.clear_H_true: If baseline action0 value is nonzero, emit action0 value0 and set agent.set_acc_z_z=0 before the next frozen inference; retain all other fields. If already0 there is no command difference.
output_contract.predict_M_WAYPOINT: Only if exactly one baseline action4 addresses original target, replace that row with [2,actor,point_lon,point_lat]. Official converter gives ground altitude0. Otherwise preserve baseline commands.
output_contract.predict_M_KEEP: Preserve original target command. No home-only fallback on failed history/alignment guards.
output_contract.ordering: Frozen baseline inference/mask and original mission goal are computed first. Skill changes emitted action0/action4 afterward. Candidate feedback of actual last maneuver is updated as measured. P intentionally does not rewrite the baseline model goal. Satellite schedule and original targets remain unchanged.
output_contract.receipts: Normal official native handlers execute first; passive same-step receipts must match every changed command. Invalid receipt invalidates evidence, not a silent successful fallback.
output_contract.no_h_activation_gate_for_P: Selected HP enables both components from the beginning. Do not add a requirement that some H clear action occurred, or encode the observed forkstep359 as a runtime trigger.

empirically_selected.name: H clear_range_m
empirically_selected.basis: Earlier matched CLEAR2/CLEAR5/CLEAR10 comparison; selected2km had best original sentry coverage. Threshold not proven optimal.

empirically_selected.name: components
empirically_selected.basis: Both HP/HCP scored100 in complete8-arm job; predeclared fewer-components tie rule selectsHP.

parameter_provenance.not_learned_split_claim: These guards were specified before this factorial and compile the tested mechanism. No data-driven claim that180s,100m,5000m or30m/s are optimal or individually necessary.

empirical_support_boundary.observed_P_points: All emitted P points had home_segment_fraction=1. The interpolation branch0<f<1 is implemented but not empirically exercised by changed commands in this job.
empirical_support_boundary.home_only_alternative: Untested; current result does not establish necessity of velocity/alignment/history versus public-home aiming for these actors.
empirical_support_boundary.H_effect: Only three H actors actually changed maneuver commands; repairs to other original H missions are indirect total-policy outcomes.
empirical_support_boundary.conditional_risk: P alone harmed the mother outcome. Same legal stale features do not distinguish the successful HP environment from harmful P. This tree is an exact mechanism extraction, not a validated general success predictor.
